summary: Unlocks institutional capital for greenfield infrastructure and commercial real estate development.

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 SEBI Proposes REITs & InvITs Investment in Under-Construction Third-Party Assets. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Unlocks institutional capital for greenfield infrastructure and commercial real estate development.

📌 **Core Policy Directives & Scope:**
Exposure Norms: Allows minority non-controlling stakes within existing exposure limits.

💰 **Financial Outlays & Operational Rules:**
Cooling-off Period: Proposed reduction from 12 weeks to 8 weeks for illiquid privately placed InvITs.
⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
